aggregates.name: Market
aggregates.acceptance_scope: deterministic BTCUSDT market sensing through Binance Futures Testnet public read-only data, including canonical confirmed-candle provenance, adversarial fail-closed integrity, immediate provider availability and four-sample sustained freshness over at least 15 minutes; candidate 3.6.0.0 SHA-256 5d06653b099e46b222aeaee47e022ef61d28bb3e3bb188c9b6b88a494b7ec5be; excludes Mainnet, mutation, credentials, private account data, other symbols and other providers

capabilities.name: Orchestrator/control
capabilities.acceptance_scope: deterministic seven-role canonical chain with mandatory fail-closed pre-authorization gate and atomic append-only output/handoff persistence; no live Testnet mutation certification

capabilities.name: Market Data
capabilities.acceptance_scope: deterministic confirmed-candle market facts with source-time freshness, Testnet provider-bound canonical provenance and complete realtime enrichment gates; no raw HTTP response retention or live provider certification

capabilities.name: News
capabilities.acceptance_scope: bounded canonical News evidence with allowlisted publisher/HTTPS-host identity, UTC freshness, duplicate rejection, structured field validation and article-text exclusion from Agent audit; no live source availability certification or narrative truth claim

capabilities.name: Macro
capabilities.acceptance_scope: bounded observation-only ingestion for two allowlisted official BLS series with pinned endpoints, raw-evidence hashes, append-only revisions, optional official release-calendar correlation and degraded last-known-fact retention; no forecast, causal trading claim or target-machine live availability certification

capabilities.name: Technical
capabilities.acceptance_scope: versioned technical fact validation and deterministic weighted signal aggregation over canonical Market evidence; no independent recomputation or live certification of provider multi-timeframe indicators

capabilities.name: Fundamental
capabilities.acceptance_scope: bounded Binance Futures Testnet venue-instrument facts from the official exchangeInfo endpoint, with exact provider/environment/symbol identity, active perpetual status, coherent base/quote/margin assets, onboard time, freshness and canonical evidence hashes; no protocol, issuer, tokenomics, on-chain, valuation or investment conclusion

capabilities.name: Strategy
capabilities.acceptance_scope: deterministic current-instrument executable-plan validation bound to one eligible assessment and the exact approved/promoted research strategy version, with bounded confidence/tier and directional price geometry; no autonomous strategy discovery, full lifecycle acceptance or live Testnet performance certification

capabilities.name: Backtest
capabilities.acceptance_scope: versioned deterministic validation facts bound to the exact canonical symbol, strategy version, UTC freshness, finite bounded metrics, coherent lifecycle state and tamper-evident Strategy source; no live Testnet performance certification or causal claim

capabilities.name: Execution
capabilities.acceptance_scope: deterministic execution contract boundary only; no Testnet claim

capabilities.name: Position
capabilities.acceptance_scope: deterministic position quantity, protection and external-isolation gates with same-cycle mutation invalidation; no live Testnet provider certification

capabilities.name: Review/post-trade
capabilities.acceptance_scope: deterministic confirmed-close accounting with idempotent PnL, fee, funding, slippage and bounded strategy identity; no broad causal-performance claim

capabilities.name: Teacher
capabilities.acceptance_scope: deterministic daily market brief from eligible canonical Research; opt-in notification only
